content.title: WWE WrestleMania 42 Night 2 Highlights: Roman Reigns Beats CM Punk; Brock Lesnar Retires
content.text: WWE WrestleMania 42 LIVE: Roman Reigns wins! Two mega spears and Roman Reigns has done it! What a main event! Reigns held his nerve and he has defeated CM Punk to become the new WWE World Champion. WWE WrestleMania 42 LIVE: Festival of submissions This has been an exciting main event till now. A guillotine by Reigns followed by an Anaconda Vice by Punk and even a Sharpshooter attempt. The submission moves are not ending in this fight but still no winner. WWE WrestleMania 42 LIVE: Near falls galore It is near falls after near falls in this match. Punk was able to hit a GTS but Reigns was not pinned. He, in turn, was able to hit the spear but Punk survived with a two-count. WWE WrestleMania 41, Night 2 LIVE: CM Punk in trouble CM Punk is in deep trouble as he is left bloody after repeated attacks on the head by Roman Reigns. Punk was attacked with the steel steps and then put through the announce table as Reigns look to complete a dominant victory. WWE WrestleMania 42 LIVE: Total Mayhem The two wrestlers have given it their all thill now. A pretty even fight till now as Punk and Reigns both had their moments. However, none of them have been able to come up with something special to win it. WWE WrestleMania 42 LIVE: Roman Reigns Roman Reigns is making his way to the ring. A huge fight awaits! WWE WrestleMania 41, Night 2 LIVE: Time for the main event It has been an exciting show till now and it is finally time for the main event - CM Punk vs Roman Reigns! WWE WrestleMania 42 LIVE: New champion crowned Rhea Ripley pulled off a perfect Riptide and she is the new WWE Women's Champion. Cargill had her moments but Ripley did not lose heart and with Iyo Sky taking care of the interferences, hereby begins a new reign for Ripley. WWE WrestleMania 42 LIVE: Iyo Sky is here It looked like Jade Cargill will have the numbers' advantage but Iyo Sky is here and she quickly made sure that Ripley had no disadvatnage! WWE WrestleMania 42 LIVE: WWE Women's Championship Time for the second-last match of the night. Rhea Ripley take on champion Jade Cargill for the WWE Women's Championship. WWE WrestleMania 42 LIVE: Finn Balor wins Fun Balor wins! A slingblade followed by a coup de grace. It was a fight that Balor largely dominated and it came as no surprise that he was the winner. WWE WrestleMania 42 LIVE: Violent tendencies Both Finn Balor and Dominik Mysterio did not hesitate to introduce weapons in this fight. A hit to the back by a steel chair and Doninik is struggling. WWE WrestleMania 42 LIVE: Street Fight Next up, it is a street fight between Dominik Mysterio and 'The Demon' Finn Balor. WWE WrestleMania 42 LIVE: New champion alert Two trick-shot finishers and Trick Williams has done it. He pinned Sami Zayn and we have a brand new WWE US Champion! WWE WrestleMania 42 LIVE: Zayn all the way Sami Zayn may not have the people's support at this time but he has been very impressive. He has controlled the pace of the fight and Trick is struggling to find a way to make a comeback. WWE WrestleMania 42 Night 2 LIVE: US Championship match Time for the WWE US Championship match and the champion Sami Zayn will take on Trick Williams. WWE WrestleMania 42 LIVE: Penta retains An exciting fight ends with Penta climbing the latter and retaining his WWE Intercontinental title. A lot of high spots in the fight but Penta was smart to take his time and strike at the right moment. WWE WrestleMania 42 LIVE: Dangerous spot A Mexican destroyer from Penta on JD on top of a ladder. This is just too dangerous! Absolute carnage as everyone tries to get the gold. WWE WrestleMania 42 LIVE: High flying clash The ladder match has been full of high-flying shots specifically featuring Rey Mysterio, Penta and Dragon Lee. J'von has already established himself as an exciting young talent and he has been one of the most exciting stars in the recent past. WWE WrestleMania 42 LIVE: Ladder match up next Up next is the ladder match for the Intercontinental Championship -- Penta (c) vs. Je'Von Evans vs. Dragon Lee vs. JD McDonagh vs. Rusev vs. Rey Mysterio. WWE WrestleMania 42 LIVE: Brock Lesnar retires Brock Lesnar took off his wrestling gear and left it at the middle of the ring after the match. He has retired from WWE and the crowd is chanting 'Thank you Brock'. A emotional hug with Paul Heyman and one of the greatest champions of the company walks away. WWE WrestleMania 42 LIVE: Oba Femi wins A F5 from Brock Lesnar but Oba Femi is not bothered. A chokeslam followed by a powerbomb and Femi has won this fight. Huge moment for him and this can propel him to superstardom! WWE WrestleMania 42 LIVE: Lesnar in control Brock Lesnar started strong and the experience is clear from how he has controlled the match till now. Oba Femi tried to counter with his explosive power but Brock Lesnar is not allowing him to make a comeback. WWE WrestleMania 42 Night 2 LIVE: Time for Brock Lesnar Accompanied by Paul Heyman, Brock Lesnar is here! Easily one of the most iconic entrances in WWE history and the crowd is pumped! WWE WrestleMania 42 LIVE: John Cena is here WrestleMania 42 host John Cena is here and he kicked off the show for the second time in two days. The first match is a big one with Oba Femi taking on Brock Lesnar. WWE WrestleMania 42 LIVE: It is time! It is time for WrestleMania 42 Night 2! Night 1 featured some shocking moments with Paige making her return and Cody Rhodes defeating Randy Orton in a bloody main event. Can Night 2 match that hype? WWE WrestleMania 42 LIVE: Complete match card Oba Femi vs. Brock Lesnar Intercontinental Championship -- Penta (c) vs. Je'Von Evans vs. Dragon Lee vs. JD McDonagh vs. Rusev vs. Rey Mysterio (Ladder Match) WWE Women's Championship -- Jade Cargill (c) vs. Rhea Ripley United States Championship -- Sami Zayn (c) vs. Trick Williams Finn Balor vs. Dominik Mysterio World Heavyweight Championship -- CM Punk (c) vs. Roman Reigns WWE WrestleMania 42 LIVE: Hello and welcome Welcome to the live coverage of Night 2 of WrestleMania 42! A star-studded night with CM Punk taking on Roman Reigns in the main event and Brock Lesnar clashing with Oba Femi in a match for the ages.
